title: Bitget public listing transport and current futures risk-tier evidence

scope.objective: Use first-party client configuration or official documentation to identify the public historical-depth listing transport, and collect an official current maintenance-margin tier specification.
exclusions: No guessed archive GETs; the prior bounded 404/405 GET probes were not repeated.
No credentials, account access, orders, private endpoints, Binance, bulk archive downloads, production changes, or executable-PnL claims.
No claim that current risk tiers are historical tiers or establish a historical liquidation price.

budget.whole_command_elapsed_seconds: Completed before the 30-second tool wait elapsed; exact elapsed time was not recorded.
notes: The 12 transactions include repeated retrievals of the same official JS bundles used to isolate the relevant helper modules; repeated responses had matching body lengths and SHA-256 values.
The one HTTP 301 was not followed. No redirected request was issued.
The last public listing call was not attempted because the authorized 12-transaction ceiling was reached.

official_data_download_page.note: The current page was used to establish the page origin and locate its page bundle.

selected_source: The page invokes R with displaySymbol, businessLine, businessType, dateType, beginTimeStr, endTimeStr, and optionally deptType; the function feeds the resulting records' fileUrl/fileName to download links.
The sibling getSymbolList helper is also called with displaySymbol, businessLine, businessType, and languageType.
official_page_client.selection_note: Selected exact call-site strings from the full response; full JS body was not retained.

selected_helper_configuration: The endpoint wrapper sets method to POST when the endpoint config omits method: `const t=e.endpoint,n=e.method,i=void 0===n?"POST":n`.
Its dispatch uses the corresponding GET/POST/PUT/DELETE helper; the POST branch calls `post({url:t,data:e,...n})`.
The browser client prefixes requests with `/v1`: `S({requestOptions:{urlPrefix:"/v1"}})`.

route_assessment.method: POST (default explicitly selected by the official helper for this endpoint configuration)
route_assessment.host_confidence: The endpoint is a relative browser-client URL and the official page is served from www.bitget.com; the inspected helper excerpt does not itself specify an absolute base host or rule out a runtime origin override.
route_assessment.read_only_assessment: The cited page calls the endpoint to retrieve a list of downloadable file URLs from user-selected symbol/type/date filters; it does not call an order, account, or authentication action. This is client evidence for a read-only data listing, not a separately published API contract.

request_not_sent.reason: The 12-request maximum was reached while resolving method, path, host context, and current risk-tier evidence.
unresolved: No POST response, listing, or direct file URL was observed.
The client call-site names and sends businessLine/businessType values, but the reviewed evidence does not establish that the previously tried values 2/3 select futures depth.
No exact supported listing contract, archive sample, or sample schema/coverage was verified.

prior_archive_evidence_reused.conclusion_preserved: Bitget advertises recent historical futures depth downloads. Earlier GET failures did not establish archive absence, private access, or executable-price coverage.

archive_listing.transport_result: The cited official client supplies new evidence that the listing helper defaults to POST and that the browser client prefixes /v1. The likely URL is https://www.bitget.com/v1/statistics/public/download/getPublicDataV2, but the host remains inferred from same-origin page context, not an explicit absolute base URL in the inspected configuration. No POST was sent.

documented_semantics.keepMarginRate: Maintenance-margin rate corresponding to the position-size tier; when the position margin rate is below this maintenance-margin rate, forced partial or full liquidation is triggered.

selected_claims: The article describes position tiers as position-value bands with maximum leverage decreasing and initial/maintenance margin requirements increasing at higher tiers.
Its illustrative formula is maintenance margin = position value × the tier's maintenance-margin rate.
official_support_explanation.limitation: The article's BTC tier table is explicitly an example and is not substituted for the live per-contract API response.

interpretation_limits: These are current public tier schedules for BTCUSDT and AAPLUSDT only, not schedules for every researched contract.
Position tiers and maintenance rates can change; these live responses do not establish values for the historical research window.

The public tier endpoint does not calculate an account's liquidation price. No account or position state, margin mode, mark-price history, fees-at-liquidation, funding ledger, or historical tier schedule was retrieved.
Do not turn this current snapshot into historical liquidation or executable-PnL results.

required_missing_inputs: Supported listing response and a downloadable historical futures-depth sample.
Sample symbol/product and timestamp identity, saved-window coverage, gaps, bid/ask level order/quantities, and snapshot/delta/sequence semantics.
Historical point-in-time margin-tier schedules and liquidation rules if historical liquidation levels are to be simulated.
explicitly_not_done: No quotes or depth were downloaded or validated.
No executable prices, fills, margin, liquidation price, or PnL were computed.
No code gate or tests were added; this is a metadata-only evidence artifact.
execution_input_gate.next_official_step: If a follow-up budget is authorized, use the exact first-party client-inferred POST route only after verifying the product-type values for futures depth from official client/docs; retrieve a single capped listing/sample, validate its schema and UTC coverage, and separately request historical tier effective dates/rules from Bitget.
